linux.notes: REDlauncher waits for a click under Proton; DX12 is the build that ships the upscalers. FSR Frame Generation is disabled while Reflex is on.

windows.notes: REDlauncher waits for a click under Proton; DX12 is the build that ships the upscalers. FSR Frame Generation is disabled while Reflex is on. On Windows the launcher skip is left out: it only matters under Proton. The XeSS input hint was measured on Linux only and is left out.
